name: Percent to decimal
rule: Percent means per 100, so slide the decimal point two places left: 35% = 0.35, 4% = 0.04, 0.8% = 0.008. To go back, slide it two places right.
why: A percent is a fraction out of 100. Dividing by 100 moves every digit two places to the right of where it was, and the point ends up two places left.

clues: Percent means out of 100. What do you do to the decimal point?
Slide the decimal point two places left (add zeros if you need them).
Going the other way: multiply by 100. What happens to the decimal point?
Slide the decimal point two places right.
